name: sessio
description: Always-on scratch-file discipline: a single SessionStart hook injects a primer that routes temporary and generated files into a per-task dated subdirectory (<base>/YYYY-MM-DD--<desc>) of a scratch root, instead of scattering them across the working directory, home, or system temp. The root is read from the CLAUDE_SESSIONS_DIR environment variable (user/OS-specific, never hardcoded); when it is unset the primer onboards — it has the agent ask the user for a base directory and persist CLAUDE_SESSIONS_DIR for future sessions. No commands, no state, cross-platform, zero dependencies.
